properties.field_evidence: Official Cherwell District Council Decision Notice for 24/01712/F grants permission for the erection of one garden outbuilding at 69 Bretch Hill, Banbury. Condition 2 requires the development to accord with the site location plan (1:1250), block plan (1:500), and drawings titled 'Proposed Garden Building Elevation' and 'Ground Floor Plan'. Condition 3 identifies the subject as an outbuilding ancillary/incidental to the dwellinghouse. Count one distinct planned garden outbuilding. Geometry/materialization deferred to local OpenCode.
